summary: Destructor/cleanup routine that walks four per-cluster array pointers at stride 296 bytes (74 dwords), starting at offset 0x1F4. For each slot it zeroes the count field preceding the pointer, frees the allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the pointer is non-null, then zeroes the pointer itself. Invoked from VehicleResetClear during vehicle state reset.

operations.description: Seed loop counter v2 = 4 (four array slots).
Point v1 at the first array pointer, this + 125 dwords = offset 0x1F4.
do-while loop running exactly 4 iterations, advancing v1 by 74 dwords (296 bytes) per iteration; cleanup of cluster storage arrays invoked from VehicleResetClear.
Read current array pointer *v1 into result.
Guard on the current array pointer at offset 0x1F4: when it equals 0, the FreeWrapper_7bcf call is skipped for this slot.
Zero the count field immediately preceding the pointer at *(v1 - 1).
Conditionally call FreeWrapper_7bcf(result) to free the heap-allocated array when the pointer was non-null.
Zero the current array pointer *v1 = 0 after freeing.
Advance v1 by 74 dwords to the next slot and decrement the counter.
Return the last free/discarded pointer value (legacy ABI name Array_Cleanup).

unresolved: Owning class and layout of the four cluster storage arrays are unknown; the stride 296-byte entries are inferred from the source.
The count field zeroed at *(v1 - 1) (the dword immediately before offset 0x1F4) is not independently evidenced by the packet.
